## setting
**53 run(s)** — rule `lewis24-setting` — 10.1111/nph.19864  
*Supporting Information, Notes S1 section 1, 'RNA-seq of P. graminis-infected leaf samples'*

> Total RNA was extracted from the leaves or stems of 26 Pgt-infected bread wheat (Triticum aestivum) plants collected in the UK (six in 2021 and 20 in 2022), six collected in Germany, eight collected in France, one collected in Uganda and 11 collected in South Africa using a Qiagen RNeasy Mini Kit (Qiagen, UK) (Dataset S2). [...] cDNA libraries were prepared using an Illumina TruSeq RNA Sample Preparation Kit and sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq instrument by Azenta Life Sciences.
